verdict.rationale: Reporting dashboards are a fair question for a project-management tool like Shortcut, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents building dashboards, widgets, or progress reports. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Roadmap visualization of Epics, communicating health status, and a REST API a developer could use to construct custom reporting.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
